__comment: The tool rack (doc 294): the first storage furniture. A plank piece since doc 308 (the owner's pick A of two, 2026-11-13, the peg rail): one broad sawn board flat on the wall, pegged to it, with three stout pegs for the tools. Its Tier 1 form was half a split log lashed to two wall pegs, bark side out (the owner's pick of three ways to draw it, 2026-11-11), whose design is kept in tools/hearthblock/art/tier1.mjs. Tier 2 Hearthblock model from tools/hearthblock/art/tier2.mjs.

Carpenters make it at the carpenter's bench from one log; it keeps its wood. It hangs on a wall over the three floor cells its tools hang into, so dwarves walk round it (floor_wall: a wall behind every cell).

storage (ContainerStorageComponent): it holds tools (the tool tag), one on each of its three hooks, starting at priority 4, ahead of ground storage. The anchors are the hooks, in footprint-local blocks from the back-left floor corner; hang hangs each tool upright from its top.
description: A broad sawn board pegged to a wall, with three stout pegs to hang tools on. It keeps three of the colony's tools where everyone can see them.
